requires: Parent-supplied accepted exact R06 and N04 publisher commits and complete source-bound anchor
Source review and explicit native authorization, followed by coordinated resource ownership

cases.permit: Real R03/R06 delivery reaches the configured model through Caddy and the actual post-auth N05 gate; the intended synthetic provider observes success.
cases.deny: The same key cannot use another model/target, manage keys, or connect directly to the live backend; denied provider counters remain unchanged.

cases.permit: Original and replacement credentials are separately obtained through real R03/R06 references for the same owner. After clearing the R07 credential deny, only a fresh delivery supplies recovery.
cases.deny: The actual private NativeKeyClient.info probe must observe healthy native retirement before a native-auth 401 is counted. The old key remains absent/refused after feed removal and fresh recovery; no association rewrite, maintenance pause or resurrection.

cases.permit: Both complete, current real publishers are readable by the actual gateway and allow the authorized request.
cases.deny: An invocation-owned missing/corrupt export cannot turn a managed key into legacy; restoration recovers without renewed snapshot age.

cases.permit: Real R06 issuance/maintenance and N04 reconciliation replace each publisher-owned export; actual N04/R06/N05 readers retain access through the metadata group.
cases.deny: Readers cannot write snapshots or traverse publisher signing/state/escrow or the separate token-delivery directory. Confirm private paths exist from their owner before counting refusal.

cases.permit: The same actual W03 helper PID reads a new real N04 publication, infers through the gateway, then writes its matching acknowledgement.
cases.deny: Old/forged acknowledgement and unreadable/missing delivery cannot acknowledge the replacement or trigger a direct-provider fallback.

cases.permit: Actual old/new service keys work during acknowledgement-bound overlap; controller and W03 retain only their documented delivery/ack access.
cases.deny: The retired key stops working after the real deadline; metadata-only readers cannot read either raw key or management credentials.

cases.permit: The actual R07 feed permits current eligible model use; only verified human admin eligibility may use the documented freshness exception with a durable alert.
cases.deny: Known denies, missing ownership, expiry, service identities and native roles do not gain a freshness-based authorization bypass.
cases.fallback_requirement: Same-key recovery/live N05-hook coverage requires a separate explicitly observed bounded native-revocation-failure fixture. Healthy deletion and an unexplained 401/403 are not hook coverage.

excluded: Newly executed model permits or completed gates in this source-only tranche
Full protocol, stream, worker/cache, browser, N06 or N07 coverage
Production activation, live identities, paid models or household providers
